elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Vendor shall (a) ... provide reasonable transition assistance

elements.element: Transition assistance available for up to 6 months
Transition assistance priced at then-current rates
Return of Customer Data within 30 days of expiry or termination
elements.evidence: within 30 days after expiry or termination, return all Customer Data

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format
Deletion of Customer Data after return
elements.evidence: (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems
and certify such deletion in writing
for up to 6 months (exceeds and encompasses 90 days)
within 30 days after expiry or termination, return all Customer Data

reasons: All preferred atomic elements are present in operative language: 6-month transition assistance at then-current rates, 30-day return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format running from expiry or termination (not from a request), and deletion with written certification following return.

The insertion is a concise new Section 10.3 filling a genuine gap in Section 10; existing paragraphs 10.1 and 10.2 (Deliverable delivery, refunds, surviving rights) are untouched and remain effective.

Minor, non-material qualifiers: transition assistance is conditioned on 'at Customer's request' and qualified as 'reasonable'. These attach only to the assistance limb and do not condition the mandatory data return, deletion, or certification, so the preferred position is preserved; worth noting in the rationale only.
No undefined terms or dangling mechanics are introduced; 'Customer Data' and 'Vendor' are defined terms.
